meta.title: Font tune (dsh-fonttune)
meta.description: Interface and conversation fonts, size, weight and line height, CJK type shaping (tracking, paragraph gaps, first-line indent), code extras and presets

en.card.description: Interface and conversation fonts, size, weight and line height, CJK type shaping, code extras and presets

en.card.title: Font tune
en.dialog.hint: Applies to the conversation markdown (paragraphs, tables, headings); code surfaces keep the code font.

en.dialogEast.label: Conversation · CJK
en.dialogWest.label: Conversation · Western
en.feat.hint: Advanced font-feature-settings value, e.g. "ss01" on, "cv01" 1. Invalid values are ignored.
en.feat.label: Feature settings
en.lig.hint: Programming ligatures render multiple characters as one glyph (=> as an arrow, != as ≠). Browsers enable them by default.
en.lig.label: Code ligatures
en.line.codeHint: Adds {offset} to code line heights only; 0 keeps DSH's own line heights.
en.line.dialogHint: Scales every conversation line height by {ratio}. 100% keeps DSH's own line heights.
en.mode.label: Edit mode
en.mode.simpleHint: Manages only the front two slots of the stack — Western, then CJK. Everything you ordered in Advanced stays untouched.
en.mono.hint: Applies to code blocks, inline code and monospaced text. Empty leaves DSH's own stack.
en.mono.label: Code font
en.monoEast.label: Code · CJK
en.monoWest.label: Code · Western
en.panel.masterHint: A dot in the page corner opens quick controls for the conversation's size, line spacing and weight. Off hides the dot everywhere.
en.panel.settingsMissing: This deployment exposes no settings screen for the plugin.
en.panel.title: Quick tune

en.sans.hint: Each family is tried in order: put a Latin face first and CJK faces after it. Empty leaves DSH's own stack.
en.sans.label: Interface font
en.sansEast.label: Interface · CJK
en.sansWest.label: Interface · Western
en.shape.breakHint: Keeps Chinese punctuation and small kana from starting a line when the text wraps.
en.shape.indentHint: Indents the first line of each conversation paragraph by {offset}; 0 leaves paragraphs flush left. Paragraphs only — headings, lists and code keep their own alignment.
en.shape.letterHint: Adds {offset} to the conversation's own letter spacing; 0 keeps DSH's own tracking. Positive values open the text up, negative values tighten it.
en.shape.paragraphHint: Adds {offset} to the space between conversation paragraphs; 0 keeps DSH's own paragraph spacing. Headings keep their own spacing either way.
en.shape.wordHint: Adds {offset} to the gaps between words in the conversation; 0 keeps DSH's own word gaps. Only Latin text has word gaps to widen.
en.size.codeHint: Adds {offset} to code blocks and inline code only; the interface offset does not reach them. 0 keeps DSH's sizes.
en.size.dialogHint: Adds {offset} to the conversation text sizes, on top of DSH's own font-size setting. 0 keeps DSH's sizes.
en.smoothing.hint: How the strokes are drawn: sharp is crisp and firm, smooth is soft and even.
en.smoothing.label: Text rendering
en.stack.denied: Font access was refused, so the built-in list is shown; any name can still be typed.
en.stack.hintOrder: Earlier entries win; the first installed family is the one used.
en.stack.loading: Reading the families installed on this machine…
en.stack.unsupported: This browser cannot list installed fonts, so the built-in list is shown; any name can still be typed.
en.status.title: In force
en.status.uiFollowsNote: the interface uses the conversation's font
en.status.usesHost: not set here: DSH's own font
en.status.usesInterface: not set on its own: uses the interface font
en.synth.boldHint: For faces without a real bold: bold text stops being thickened artificially. (Disabling it lets the browser fake a bold face, which adds one extra step for a font that ships none — it cannot invent the middle ones.)
en.synth.italicHint: CJK faces have no italic, so the browser tilts them. On keeps marked text upright. (Same as faux bold: one extra step at most.)
en.synth.simpleHint: Stops synthetic italic and synthetic bold everywhere; switch to Advanced to set them apart. (Both switches: one extra step at most, no middle ones.)
en.theme.label: Light/dark sync
en.theme.sharedHint: Light and dark share this one set of settings.
en.theme.splitHint: Editing the dark set: only the items you change are overridden, the rest follow the light set.
en.ui.followHint: Font and weight. While this is on, the interface section's own values are ignored.
en.weight.codeHint: Adds to the weight of each code surface (code blocks, inline code, terminal output); 0 or unset keeps DSH's own weight. The slider is divided into the weights the current font can actually render, so the readout counts STEPS (0 = leave DSH alone); every notch makes body text and headings a little bolder or lighter, and another font offers a different number of steps. The step is measured for the current font, and its smallest step is the one that looks weakest.
en.weight.dialogHint: Adds to the weight of each conversation element, so headings stay bolder than body text and bold text stays bold. Unset keeps DSH's own weights. The slider is divided into the weights the current font can actually render, so the readout counts STEPS (0 = leave DSH alone); every notch makes body text and headings a little bolder or lighter, and another font offers a different number of steps. The step is measured for the current font, and its smallest step is the one that looks weakest.
en.weight.uiHint: Adds to the weight of the whole interface (sidebars, settings, buttons, headings): a positive value is bolder, a negative one lighter. The conversation keeps its own. The slider is divided into the weights the current font can actually render, so the readout counts STEPS (0 = leave DSH alone); every notch makes body text and headings a little bolder or lighter, and another font offers a different number of steps. The step is measured for the current font, and its smallest step is the one that looks weakest.
en.write.reverted: The setting did not reach the document, so it fell back to what the document holds.
